events.text: Every cheaper option has already been turned down, so I'm stopping there. The next step is to explain the reasoning and lay out the underlying concepts for the user.

I couldn't make the logos. Your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits, so every attempt was refused and no images were created.

I tried twice. First I used qwen-image-2.1, a free-plan model that's good at spelling text in images (about 10 credits per image). Then I tried z-image-turbo, one of the cheapest free-plan models (about 5 credits per image). All six requests were refused for lack of credits. Each request was set to one separate square image at 640 × 640 px, with no collage.

These are the three concepts I planned. They're ready to run once you have credits:

1. **Wheel-leaf emblem (stacked):** A bicycle wheel outline whose spokes form a single green moss leaf, above "Moss & Mile" in a clean, bold sans-serif font. The letters are black and the "&" is green.
2. **Road-and-hills badge (side by side):** A small round badge with green rolling hills and a black road winding through them, next to "Moss & Mile" in an elegant black serif font on one line.
3. **Fern chainring (text on top):** "Moss & Mile" in a slanted, narrow black sans-serif font that suggests speed, above a small green fern curl whose spiral is made from a bike chainring.

All three are green and black on white, with flat colours, no extra text and plenty of white space.

To go ahead, you'd need to add credits to your Magic Hour account by waiting for free credits to refill or buying a credit pack. Three images would cost roughly 15–30 credits, depending on the model. Once you have credits, tell me and I'll run all three. If you'd like any concept changed first, just say.
